scope: Local native SQLite, Chromium settings, compiled packages, and real Workerd A/B/Gateway lifecycle. Fault-injected tests do not measure hosted latency. No Cloudflare deployment.

build.scope: Local release build start times follow the final Cloudflare Rust source changes. Hashes identify the tested modules.

loading.scope: Static ESM import graph. Dynamic operations load their implementations on use. This does not measure browser network timing.

metadataRepair.scope: Build-tooling metadata regression under FORCE_COLOR=1. Regenerated JSON from recorded build values. Worker binaries and recorded build times stay unchanged.

browser.test: ML-DSA setup resumes after cancellation and checks enrollment without changing the default
browser.scope: Real Wallet settings with controlled ML-DSA metadata and NEAR RPC. No ML-DSA key generation or export claim.

producer.scope: SQLite admission and producer restart lifecycle. Publication is confirmed by a host fixture. Worker E2Es cover actual preparation and paired publication.

worker.scope: Local workerd, real strict Worker bundles, synthetic canonical wallet key, typed Gateway owner admission, and durable signing. Verified factor inputs, claimed-operation persistence, and custody activation are injected. HTTP login, public session routes, and hosted latency remain outside this test.

terminalFailures.scope: Public Gateway/SDK with WebAuthn and real Worker admission, paired material consumption, completion, and exact replay. Terminal causes are injected at the authenticated completion boundary. Cryptographic rejection is not simulated as a successful signature.
